details: Bloomberg Intelligence senior commodity strategist Mike McGlone has warned that a clearer buying opportunity for cryptocurrencies might only emerge after the Bloomberg Galaxy Crypto Index falls as much as 50% from its recent peak. He cited continued volatility, weak price retention, and an oversupply of millions of tokens as contributing factors to mounting pressure on digital assets. At the time of reporting, Bitcoin was priced at $79,254.55.
title: Bloomberg Strategist Warns Crypto May Face 50% Drop

details: Tether, a leading stablecoin issuer, is collaborating with Canaan, a prominent Bitcoin mining equipment manufacturer, to develop modular Bitcoin mining systems. This move signifies Tether's increasing involvement in Bitcoin infrastructure.
title: Tether Develops Modular Bitcoin Mining Systems with Canaan

details: Amboss has introduced RailsX, a new platform designed to facilitate self-custodial Bitcoin and stablecoin trading directly on the Lightning Network. This development aims to enhance the utility and accessibility of decentralized finance on Bitcoin's layer-2 solution.
title: Amboss Launches RailsX for Self-Custodial Bitcoin and Stablecoin Trading on Lightning

details: Visa is reportedly partnering with WeFi, a company co-founded by a former CEO of Tether, to integrate cryptocurrency functionalities into its existing payment network. This collaboration could further bridge traditional finance with the crypto ecosystem.
title: Visa Taps Former Tether CEO's WeFi to Connect Crypto to Payment Network

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has requested public comments on NYSE Arca's proposal for an 85% eligible-asset rule concerning crypto exchange-traded fund (ETF) listings. This is a step in the ongoing regulatory process for crypto investment products.
title: US SEC Seeks Comment on NYSE Arca's Crypto ETF Proposal

details: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have experienced a halt in outflows, breaking a nine-day streak, as the market tests support levels near $77,000. This occurs ahead of the upcoming Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, which could influence market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Snap Nine-Day Streak Ahead of FOMC

details: Block, the financial technology company led by Jack Dorsey, announced that it held $2.2 billion worth of Bitcoin on its balance sheet during the first quarter. This highlights continued corporate confidence and investment in the leading cryptocurrency.
title: Jack Dorsey's Block Reveals $2.2 Billion in Bitcoin Holdings in Q1

details: A White House crypto advisor has suggested that a significant announcement regarding former President Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve is anticipated in the coming weeks. Such a development could have substantial implications for the broader crypto market.
title: White House Crypto Advisor Hints at Trump's Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Announcement

details: Bitcoin experienced a sudden price drop below $78,000 during the European market open, leading to nearly $295 million in liquidations across the crypto market. This rapid decline indicates significant selling pressure and market volatility.
title: Bitcoin Flash Crashes Below $78,000, Triggering $295M Liquidations

details: Bitcoin struggled to maintain momentum and failed to break above the $80,000 resistance level. Macroeconomic uncertainties and profit-taking activities are cited as key factors weighing on its price action, leading to a stall in its recent rally.
title: Bitcoin Fails $80K Breakout as Macro Forces Dominate Price Action

details: The supply of Shiba Inu (SHIB) continues to shrink, with reserves plummeting by over 100 trillion since 2023. This deepening supply crunch is attracting significant attention and accumulation from large institutional traders, potentially signaling bullish sentiment for the meme coin.
title: Shiba Inu Supply Crunch Deepens as Big Traders Pile In

details: Coinbase has expanded its derivatives offerings by introducing "Wall Street-style" trading for XRP futures. This move aims to provide institutional investors with more sophisticated tools and increased liquidity for trading XRP.
title: Coinbase Brings Wall Street-Style Trading to XRP Futures

details: A significant accumulation trend for Bitcoin continues in April, with a strategy involving the purchase of another $255 million in BTC. This ongoing large-scale buying indicates sustained institutional interest and confidence in Bitcoin's long-term value.
title: Strategy Buys $255M Bitcoin, Extends April BTC Accumulation Streak

details: Anthropic's new AI model, Mythos, is prompting a shift in crypto security discussions from purely smart-contract audits to broader infrastructure risks, including key management, bridges, and oracle networks. While Bitcoin's underlying cryptography remains secure, custodial services and exchanges face new AI-driven threats.
sourceName: Let's Data Science (citing CoinDesk and CNBC)
title: Anthropic's Mythos AI Raises Crypto Infrastructure Security Alarms

details: The CoinDesk Bitcoin Price Index (XBX) experienced a decline of 1.79%, settling at $76,852.18. This marks the largest percentage decrease for the index since April 18, 2026, and indicates a recent downward price movement.
sourceName: Morningstar (citing Dow Jones and CoinDesk Data)
title: Bitcoin Price Index Loses 1.79%, Drops to $76,852.18
